passive.name: Synthesis
passive.desc: +1.5 regeneration and +25% healing. Your Grass attacks heal you a little (0.4% of HP per hit, up to 5 times per second).

passive.name: Sea of Flames

passive.name: Torrent Shell
passive.desc: +15 armor. Every 8 s your shell gives you a shield worth 8% of your HP. While you have a shield, ×1.25 damage.

passive.name: Metamorphosis

passive.name: Poison Sting
passive.desc: +10% attack speed. Your crits poison and poisoned enemies take ×1.3 damage. Evolves soon (Kakuna at Lv. 8, Beedrill at Lv. 36); as Kakuna, +30 armor.

passive.name: Tailwind

passive.name: Hustle
passive.desc: +15% physical damage and +10% attack speed, in exchange for -8% max HP. Every KO cheers you on: up to ×1.2 damage.

passive.name: Sniper
passive.desc: +8% crit and +50% crit damage.

passive.name: Serpent Glare
passive.desc: +1 regen (Shed Skin). Every 4 s your gaze paralyzes the enemies in front of you (7 m).

passive.name: Static

passive.name: Sand Rush
passive.desc: +10 armor and +6% crit chance. In a sandstorm, ×1.3 speed.

passive.name: Poison Point
passive.desc: +15% max HP and +10 armor. Anyone who touches you is poisoned, poisoned enemies take ×1.1 damage and spread it when they die.

passive.name: Rivalry
passive.desc: +10% damage and +25% damage to elites, Alphas and bosses. Every elite, Alpha or boss you defeat gives you ×1.01 damage (up to ×1.25).

passive.name: Lunar Blessing
passive.desc: +20 luck and +1 regen. Your Ultimate charges 30% faster and when you cast it you recover 15% HP.

passive.name: Flash Fire
passive.desc: +20% Fire damage and +15% status damage.

passive.name: Cute Charm
passive.desc: Anyone who touches you is charmed. +5% evasion.

passive.name: Vampire
passive.desc: +8% lifesteal and +20% healing. As Golbat, +2% lifesteal and leftover healing is stored as a shield (up to 10% of your HP).

challenge.desc: Recover 4,000 HP in a single run.

passive.name: Chlorophyll
passive.desc: +10% speed and +1 regeneration. In sun, ×1.3 speed and ×1.2 damage. Every 6 s you release a pollen cloud (4.5 m) that poisons.

passive.name: Effect Spore
passive.desc: +20% status chance. Anyone who touches you falls asleep, gets paralyzed or gets poisoned. As Parasect, the mushroom is in control: ×1.2 damage against enemies with any status.

passive.name: Compound Eyes
passive.desc: +8% crit chance and +25% status chance. Confused enemies take ×1.3 damage. As Venomoth, +12% attack speed.

passive.name: Sand Trap
passive.desc: +10 armor and +10% HP. Every 2 s the ground shakes around you (4.5 m): it damages and traps enemies in the sand (root). As Dugtrio, 6 m.

passive.name: Pickup
passive.desc: +40% PokéDollars and +2 pickup range. Every 100 ₽ you earn in a run gives you +1% crit chance (up to +15%). As Persian, +10% speed.

passive.name: Headache
passive.desc: +10% HP. The hits you take and the passage of time charge your headache; when full, it bursts into a psychic wave (7 m) that damages and confuses. As Golduck, the wave is 10 m and heals you for 8%.

passive.desc: +8 armor. Fighting enrages you: +1 charge for every second in which you hit and +2 for every hit you take. ×1.04 damage per charge (up to 6 charges, ×1.24; as Primeape, up to 8, ×1.32). At max rage you take ×1.1 damage. After 3 s without fighting you lose one charge per second.

passive.name: Loyal Guardian
passive.desc: +10% speed. Every 3 s, nearby enemies are intimidated: they deal -40% damage and take ×1.15 damage.

passive.name: Swift Swim
passive.desc: +10% max HP and +20% projectile speed. In rain, ×1.3 speed and ×1.2 damage; without it, ×1.2 damage against wet enemies. As Poliwrath, +15% physical damage.

passive.name: Magic Guard
passive.desc: +10% special damage. Immune to damage from the ground (lava, fire pools, cracks, spore clouds). -30% damage from projectiles and area attacks.

passive.name: Guts
passive.desc: +25% physical damage.

passive.name: Hungry Maw
passive.desc: +10% max HP. Your Strikes and Spins deal ×1.15 damage and can root (20%). KOs of rooted enemies heal you for 2% of HP.

passive.name: Tentacles
passive.desc: +10 armor. Every 2 s your tentacles lash the 2 closest enemies within 7 m (they poison); Tentacruel lashes 4. Every 4 projectiles you have, one more tentacle (up to 4 more).

passive.name: Sturdy
passive.desc: You survive a lethal hit with 1 HP. It recharges after 120 s. +10 armor.

passive.name: Fiery Hooves
passive.desc: +15% speed. As you move you leave fire footprints that burn enemies, bigger with more area and stronger the more you run. As Rapidash, +10% speed, bigger footprints and ×1.1 damage while moving.

passive.name: Oblivious
passive.desc: +25% HP, +1.5 regen and -10% speed. Every 6 s you yawn: enemies within 6 m may fall asleep. As Slowbro, the Shellder on its tail gives you +20 armor.

passive.desc: +20% area and +1 jump. Your kicks (attacks with “kick”) deal ×1.2 damage. Every 3 s you deliver a spinning kick to enemies within 3.5 m (in the air, ×1.5 damage).

passive.desc: Water moves (and any hit on a wet enemy) heal you a little; in rain, ×1.2 damage. The first hit you take every 6 s is reduced by 60%. In exchange, -15% speed.

Defeat 15 Alpha Pokémon with Johto Pokémon.

passive.name: Little Kiss
passive.desc: +20% status chance. Every 5 s it blows a kiss at the nearest enemy and charms it; charmed enemies take ×1.25 damage. In exchange, -10% max HP.

passive.name: Dynamo
passive.desc: +10% speed. Running spins its arms and charges it up: every 60 m, a discharge jumps to 4 nearby enemies and may paralyze them. In exchange, -10% max HP.

challenge.desc: Paralyze 1,500 Pokémon in a single run that you start with a Johto Pokémon (Dunsparce paralyzes).

passive.name: Tantrum
passive.desc: Every 10 s it throws a tantrum: burns everything within 4.5 m and deals ×1.25 damage for 3 s. In exchange, -10% max HP.

challenge.desc: Burn 1,500 Pokémon in a single run with Johto Pokémon.

passive.name: Moo Moo Milk
passive.desc: +20% max HP and you take ×0.75 damage from Fire and Ice (Thick Fat). Every 15 s you leave a bottle of milk nearby; picking it up heals you for 15%. Milk Drink and Heal Bell heal you, and Wake-Up Slap deals ×1.6 damage to sleeping enemies. In exchange, -10% damage.

challenge.desc: Have 15 Johto members in your League.

passive.name: Thundering Pressure
passive.desc: Legendary: +10% damage, max HP and speed. Running at over 80% of your speed you leave a trail of lightning that paralyzes anyone who steps on it.

challenge.desc: Have 30 Johto members in your League.
Fill Raikou's tracking gauge in Ecruteak City with Johto Pokémon.
Paralyze 1,500 Pokémon in a single run that you start with a Johto Pokémon (Dunsparce paralyzes).

passive.name: Volcanic Pressure
passive.desc: Legendary: +10% damage, max HP and speed. Every 6 s a volcano (a 3 m pillar of fire) erupts under the strongest enemy and burns it.

challenge.desc: Have 32 Johto members in your League.
Fill Entei's tracking gauge in Ecruteak City with Johto Pokémon.
Burn 3,000 Pokémon in a single run with Johto Pokémon.

passive.name: Boreal Pressure
passive.desc: Legendary: +10% damage, max HP and speed. Every 5 s the north wind purifies: it heals you for 2% of your HP and wets and slows enemies within 7 m.

challenge.desc: Have 34 Johto members in your League.
Fill Suicune's tracking gauge in Ecruteak City with Johto Pokémon.
Freeze 1,500 Pokémon in a single run with Johto Pokémon.

passive.name: Sand Stream
passive.desc: +20 armor (Pupitar, +30). You carry a sandstorm with you (6 m; Tyranitar, 9 m) that deals little damage, and your Rock moves deal ×1.15 damage. With Sandstorm the aura is 30% bigger and deals double damage. -10% speed.

challenge.desc: Have 25 Johto members in your League.
Win in Ecruteak City on Hard with Johto Pokémon.

passive.name: Guardian of the Sea
passive.desc: Legendary: +10% damage, max HP and speed. Every 7 s a sea whirlpool (5 m) opens under the densest group: it pulls it in, wets it and hits it. With weather, Weather Ball deals ×1.4 damage and gives you its status; Whirlwind pushes the horde back.

challenge.desc: Have 40 Johto members in your League.
Win in Ecruteak City on Nightmare with Johto Pokémon.

passive.name: Phoenix
passive.desc: Legendary: +10% damage, max HP and speed. Once per zone (in Survival, every 5 min), when you faint you are reborn with 50% of your HP in an explosion of rainbow fire. With Safeguard, status effects don't affect you.

challenge.desc: Have 40 Johto members in your League.
Defeat Ho-Oh atop the Tin Tower on Hard with Johto Pokémon.

passive.name: Time Travel
passive.desc: Legendary: +10% damage, max HP and speed. Every 30 s you can rewind: you recover the HP you had 5 s ago (if it was higher). It is ready as soon as you have lost HP.

challenge.desc: Have 45 Johto members in your League.
Defeat Celebi in the Shrine of Time on Hard with Johto Pokémon.
